expected: Trading tokenised bonds promised major lenders instant wholesale digital market execution. Yet private distributed ledgers carried unacceptable credit and counterparty settlement hazards. Commercial tokens lacked the absolute safety found in central bank money. So the Eurosystem deployed Pontes as a dedicated wholesale settlement bridge. It connects distributed platforms directly to risk-free central reserves without friction. Now even monetary authorities settle their own tokenised investments through it.
